To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

writing with unfamiliar digital tools and technologies may reveal a great deal about the nature of writing processes, and may help to clarify the role that writing tools play in shaping writers' practices.

writing with unfamiliar digital tools and technologies can be challenging and can lead to new insights and discoveries about writing practices, and that the writing process is shaped in part by the tools and technologies used to compose.
writing tools and technologies shape the writing practices and experiences of writers in a number of important and complex ways.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of tools and technologies in the composition process.
the ways in which writing tools matter.
the ways writing technologies influence writers and their work.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of writing tools and technologies can have a profound impact on how writers approach the writing process and the way in which they compose.
this research has provided a clearer understanding of the ways writing tools may shape writing processes.

this research suggests the extent to and the ways in which writing tools and technology influence routine practices, motivate writing, and assist writers as they direct their attention (or avoid distraction) and compose.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of writing technologies can be a double-edged sword, and the ways in which we use them, and the ways that they are designed, are important considerations for all who are invested in writing.
the writing tool matters.
the writing tools and technologies that we use influence our composing practices and that we should be aware of how they do so.
The main takeaway from our work is that
writing researchers and teachers should consider the ways that writing tools shape the practices of writing, and that software developers should consider the needs of writers when designing tools.
writing technologies are not neutral.
the tools and technologies that we choose to employ for our writing matter.
